camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainAverageResponseTime --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --DomainType domaintype --EndTime '2019-11-30T05:40:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --TimeMerge 1 --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2019-11-30T05:33:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Calls DescribeDomainAverageResponseTime to query the average response time of an accelerated domain name. You can query data within the last 90 days
description_zh: 调DescribeDomainAverageResponseTime获取加速域名的平均响应时间，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-average-response-time --time-merge 1 --domain-type domaintype --domain-name example.com --start-time 2019-11-30T05:33:00Z --end-time 2019-11-30T05:40:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainAverageResponseTime

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to adaptively calculate the Interval value. If timeMerge is set to 1, an appropriate interval value is calculated based on StartTime and EndTime. You can specify this parameter or the Interval parameter
parameters.help_zh: 是否自适应计算Interval值，如果timeMerge=1，会根据startTime和endTime计算出合适的inteval值，和Interval参数任选
parameters.name: time_merge

parameters.help_en: The type of the query. If you set this parameter to dynamic, the average response time of dynamic resources and the average response time of static resources for Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) are queried. By default, this parameter is left empty, and the average response time of static resources is queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询类型。传dynamic时，查询全站加速动态资源的平均响应时间和静态资源的平均响应时间；默认不传，查询静态资源的平均响应时间
parameters.name: domain_type

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, all accelerated domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。获取日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the query. Unit: seconds. The valid values vary based on the time range specified by StartTime and EndTime:

If the time range is less than 3 days (3 days excluded), valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400. Default value: 300.

If the time range is from 3 to 31 days (31 days excluded), valid values are 3600 and 86400. Default value: 3600.

If the time range is 31 days or longer, the valid value is 86400. Default value: 86400
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。根据您指定StartTime和EndTime两者的时间跨度，该参数取值如下：

3天以内（不包含3天整）支持300、3600、 86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为300。

3-31天（不包含31天整）支持3600和86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为3600。

31天及以上支持86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为86400
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The English name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISP names. By default, all ISPs are queried
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The English name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query region names. By default, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh: 地域英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries. Unit: seconds

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range that was queried

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range that was queried
